p19_answer_after: On the DreamStation, SmartRamp mode differs from standard ramp mode in how it adjusts pressure. While a standard ramp uses a fixed time-based pressure increase (SmartRamp), SmartRamp maintains a constant lower pressure until the device detects that you require more pressure (DreamStation). In other words, SmartRamp is an intelligent ramp mode that automatically adjusts pressure based on patient breathing patterns (SmartRamp), rather than simply increasing pressure gradually over a set time period like the standard ramp function (Ramp).
